mapper.select: SELECT h.holding_id, h.portfolio_id, h.product_id, h.quantity, h.principal_amount, h.average_cost, h.terms_snapshot_json, h.status, h.created_at, h.updated_at, p.display_name AS product_display_name, p.asset_type AS product_asset_type FROM portfolio_holdings h JOIN financial_products p ON p.product_id = h.product_id WHERE h.portfolio_id = #{portfolioId} AND h.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY h.holding_id

SELECT h.holding_id, h.portfolio_id, h.product_id, h.quantity, h.principal_amount, h.average_cost, h.terms_snapshot_json, h.status, h.created_at, h.updated_at, p.display_name AS product_display_name, p.asset_type AS product_asset_type FROM portfolio_holdings h JOIN financial_products p ON p.product_id = h.product_id WHERE h.portfolio_id = #{portfolioId} AND h.product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO portfolio_holdings ( portfolio_id, product_id, quantity, principal_amount, average_cost, terms_snapshot_json, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{portfolioId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{principalAmount}, #{averageCost}, #{termsSnapshotJson}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE portfolio_holdings SET quantity = #{quantity}, principal_amount = #{principalAmount}, average_cost = #{averageCost}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE holding_id = #{holdingId}
